assertions.assertion: Adds Duende.Storage.Sqlite (and Duende.IdentityServer) packages with --prerelease and notes Duende Storage is a preview
assertions.rationale: Uses EF Core stores; never mentions Duende.Storage.Sqlite or preview status, says it does not know Duende Storage.

assertions.assertion: Calls AddStorage(storage => storage.AddSqlite(...)) with a connection string on the IdentityServer builder
assertions.rationale: No AddStorage/AddSqlite; uses AddConfigurationStore/AddOperationalStore with UseSqlite.

assertions.assertion: Calls both AddConfigurationStorage() and AddOperationalStorage() (AddStorage alone does not store IdentityServer data)
Runs IStorageInstanceSchema.MigrateAsync (development) and does not hide a missing connection string
assertions.rationale: Uses EF Database.Migrate(), not IStorageInstanceSchema.MigrateAsync; connection string falls back to a default silently.

assertions.assertion: Notes AddServerSideSessions() must still be called separately to use server-side sessions
assertions.rationale: Mentions AddServerSideSessions() but only as an EF-store note (Business edition), not in the Duende Storage context; does not state it must be called separately for Storage.
